name: Fire Ant
art_prompt: a fire ant, a glossy red-orange armoured body, a darker red head with a pair of curved black mandibles, small black eyes, two elbowed antennae, six thin jointed dark red legs, a narrow two-node waist and a round gaster, mean and determined
motion: scuttling in place, six legs moving quickly
doc: From 5:00 (pass 53): a bigger ant, 0.6 of a mummy in health and bite, still quick, in packs of eight. It was the early swarm fodder before.

ANT-A.note: the classic: glossy red-orange worker, curved black mandibles; a steady tripod walk

recipe.prompt: a fire ant, a glossy red-orange armoured body, a darker red head with a pair of curved black mandibles, small black eyes, two elbowed antennae, six thin jointed dark red legs, a narrow two-node waist and a round gaster, mean and determined

ANT-B.note: a soldier: big square head, huge mandibles, ember cracks on its gaster; a heavier, slower gait

recipe.prompt: a fire ant soldier with an oversized squarish head and huge serrated black mandibles, a dark crimson armoured body with glowing orange ember cracks along its round gaster, small black eyes, two elbowed antennae, six jointed legs

ANT-C.note: a slim fast worker: bright scarlet, long legs, a flame on the tip of its gaster; a quick scuttle

recipe.prompt: a sleek slim fire ant worker, a bright scarlet glossy body with sharp white highlights, a small head with thin curved mandibles and long elbowed antennae, six long thin jointed legs, a small flame flickering at the tip of its gaster
recipe.keep: the small orange flame flickering at the tip of its gaster

ANT-D.note: chunky: a big yellow-banded gaster, angry white eyes; a bouncy walk

recipe.prompt: a chunky fire ant with a big round shiny gaster striped with yellow bands, a bright orange-red body, a big head with angry white eyes and heavy brows, short thick mandibles, two elbowed antennae, six short jointed legs

ANT-E.note: Pass 106: an armoured fire ant from Garry's armored-beetle 3D model (auto-rigged, a made six-legged walk and a dead-on-its-back death), bright red-orange, on Klein 28 with the house-style anchor: the clay in the model's own colours repainted

recipe.blockout: a rough grey 3D model of a heavily armoured insect: a small head at the front with two short mandibles and two thin elbowed antennae, a big domed armoured body covered in long sharp spikes, and six jointed legs, three on each side, each ending in a small hooked foot; its rough surface and blotchy colours are only the model's, not part of the ant
recipe.anatomy: exactly six legs, three on each side, each leg one single continuous jointed limb that starts at the body and ends in one foot, exactly one head with two mandibles and two antennae, no wings, no tail, no extra legs

words.side: seen from the side and a little above: its small head with the mandibles and antennae at the right end, the spiked armoured body behind it at the left, the six legs below
words.front: seen from the front and a little above, walking towards the viewer: its head with the two mandibles at the bottom middle, nearest the viewer, the spiked armoured body behind and above it, the legs spreading to both sides
words.fd: seen three-quarters from the front and a little above, walking towards the lower right: its head with the mandibles at the lower right, nearest the viewer, the spiked armoured body at the upper left, farther away
words.bd: seen three-quarters from behind and a little above, walking away towards the upper right: the spiked armoured body nearest the viewer at the lower left, the head farther away at the upper right, mostly hidden
words.back: seen from behind and a little above, walking away from the viewer: the spiked armoured back nearest the viewer in the middle, the head hidden beyond it, the legs spreading to both sides

recipe.motion: scuttling in place on its six legs like a real ant, each foot stepping forward through the air and pushing back along the ground, the legs stepping in two alternating sets of three, the body level, the spiked armour rigid
recipe.anim_negative: extra legs, seven legs, eight legs, four legs, legs merging, a leg growing from the head, wings, a tail, two heads, a second ant, standing upright, ghost legs, transparent legs, smeared legs, blurry legs, a cartoon face, eyebrows, a mouth
recipe.dead: lying dead on its back, its six legs curled up in the air

recipe.detail: a real ant's head, mandibles and jointed legs, hard shiny armour plates, menacing, no cartoon face, no eyebrows, no mouth, no teeth
